name: Corrupted Whipper Root
label: Quest
description: Corrupted Whipper Root: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a whipper root plant. The visible roots of the plant appear tough and leathery, and a slimy film hangs from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You apply 3 Cenarion Plant Salves to the Whipper Root. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.
